title: Version 1.29.0
body:
Version 1.29.0

July 24th, 2023

Added:

  • Added Classic Cactus (limited for 3 days!)
  • Added Classic Purple Cactus (limited for 3 days!)
  • Added 3 new classic items to the Stud shop
  • Added hover indicators for Anchor Wand and Firefly Jar

Changed:

  • Increased loading speed of the Schematics menu

Fixed:

  • Fixed solo button not working in rare cases
